title: Filled and hidden positions displayed in WordPress native search
body:
Hi,

I found a bug in the plugin. When you setup "WP Job Manager" and set "Hide filled positions" and "Hide content within expired listings" the positions are still displayed in the WordPress native search.

#### What I Expected To Happen
I expected filled and expired position to be hidden from normal WordPress search. When the setup says so. 

#### What Happened Instead
When searching I found that all of the expired and filled positions are displayed int the native search of WordPress.

#### Steps to Reproduce the Bug
1. Install Wordpress
2. Install WP Job Manager
3. Setup WP Job Manager (enable: "Hide filled positions" and "Hide content within expired listings")
4. Create 2 Jobs
5. Expire that job first one and mark the second one as filled
6. Do search with WordPress own search function using the name of the expired job or the filled job
7. Now the expired/filled position should be displayed in the search results
author: Participant 1
